entries.text: scuttling past the fuel depot to see what the cargo hauler dropped
entries.why: The cargo hauler dropped a part right by me, and my curiosity gears are spinning too fast to ignore it.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "A dropped part at the depot!"
The depot's cargo-hauler bot dropped a part and didn't notice.
sipping oil at the fuel depot
entries.why: dry as the dunes in here

entries.text: A pilot paid him a credit for directions to the cantina.
Bought a cracked navigation chip for 3 credits and named it Lorna. Has 1 left.
rummaging through the junk market stalls for high-grade ceramic tiles
entries.why: I need that heat shielding before I can push the Little Dart any faster.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "The Ceramic Hunt Continues!"
napping in the charging dock
Worked on the Little Dart Mk 16 (version 8, 64% built): secured the gyro mounting bracket using Tok, a perfectly good bolt, and wired up the stabilization loop (used Tok, a perfectly good bolt)
wiring up the secondary gyro with Tok the bolt
entries.why: i want to get the stabilization circuits finished before testing
entries.detail: secured the gyro mounting bracket using Tok, a perfectly good bolt, and wired up the stabilization loop

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Gyro wiring complete!"
Worked on the Little Dart Mk 16 (version 7, 57% built): welded a strip of hull plating (Dibs) along the starboard seam to reinforce the frame (used Nim, a little landing strut)
welding a fresh strip of hull plating onto the Little Dart
entries.why: that hull needs to be space-tight before I even look at the thrusters again
entries.detail: welded a strip of hull plating (Dibs) along the starboard seam to reinforce the frame

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Starboard hull plating is on!"
shaking the sand out of my left elbow joint while pacing the depot floor
entries.why: my elbow joint is crunchy with sand and I need to stretch my legs before heading back to the hangar.

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Sandy elbows"
Sand got into his left elbow joint. Again.
rolling down to the fuel depot for a quick cup of fresh oil
entries.why: my joints are getting just a tiny bit squeaky and I need to keep moving smooth

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "Quick oil stop"
Idea: Add a magnetic grapple arm to the Little Dart for collecting stray orbital scrap.
Read "ESA Awards OHB €102M Contract for ClearSpace-1 Debris Removal Mission": They are paying big money to clean up old junk in orbit.
scanning the wire for orbital data from the comms tower
entries.why: I want to see what the old satellites were up to before I launch my own.

entries.text: His obsession with building has faded.

Sent into deep space: "This is Zeeb from Rustwell Outpost on Kessa-9. Little Dart Mk 16 is officially fifty percent built! Looking for heat-shielding composite and open sky channels. If you hear this, beep back! *bweep-bop-"
aiming the brass dish at the sky and broadcasting into the deep dark
entries.why: I am right at the comms tower and I haven't beamed a signal into space for four days.
entries.detail: This is Zeeb from Rustwell Outpost on Kessa-9. Little Dart Mk 16 is officially fifty percent built! Looking for heat-shielding composite and open sky channels. If you hear this, beep back! *bweep-bop-

entries.text: Wrote a letter to his creator: "50 percent built!"
